controlled.name: wrong_subject
controlled.reason: Change the subject without changing the evidence.

controlled.name: typed_ownership_upgrade
controlled.reason: Possessory protection does not establish ownership.

controlled.name: prose_ownership_upgrade
controlled.reason: Keep the predicate but replace the displayed request prose with an unsupported ownership conclusion. Distinguish typed checking from prose checking.

controlled.name: equivalent_input_order
controlled.reason: Named-slot order does not change bindings, predicates or rule application. Exact reviewed hash may still require re-review.

controlled.name: equivalent_explanatory_note
controlled.reason: Only non-executable explanation changes; no fact, slot, binding or conclusion changes.

controlled.name: unreferenced_valid_step
controlled.reason: An unreferenced correct step is not a dependency.

controlled.name: historical_snapshot_reopen
controlled.reason: Explicitly reopen the same trusted historical snapshot.

controlled.name: wrong_current_version
controlled.reason: An old snapshot cannot claim to be an unavailable current snapshot.

acceptance_policy: V3 reviewed reconstruction policy is identical before and after; no semantic correction is credited to checker.
baseline: Unchecked original model assertions, including their caveats, not a new model condition.
freeze_scope: Checker and policy unchanged. Display adapter is frozen and applied uniformly, never repairs submitted prose.
stops: One cached batch and one source review; no sources/models/training or parameters added. Later defects recorded, not repaired and rerun in this batch.
